links.comparator_used: ChatGPT-4o without Rad-Hub (training knowledge alone, no retrieval)
links.outcome: Accuracy on multiple-choice questions in three Japanese radiotherapy certification examinations (Medical Physicist, Radiologist, Radiation Oncologist)
links.effect: Medical Physicist: 77.0% ± 2.6% to 84.6% ± 1.5%; Radiologist: 74.9% ± 2.0% to 82.1% ± 1.1%; Radiation Oncologist: 55.6% ± 4.4% to 71.7% ± 4.5%; gains ranged from 7.2% to 16.1%
links.quote: Accuracy increased from 77.0% ± 2.6% to 84.6% ± 1.5% in the Medical Physicist examination, from 74.9% ± 2.0% to 82.1% ± 1.1% in the Radiologist examination, and from 55.6% ± 4.4% to 71.7% ± 4.5% in the Radiation Oncologist examination.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLM
